major_visual_regions.headline: upper area or a clear area adjacent to the product
major_visual_regions.features: near the relevant product area or in one easy-to-scan group
major_visual_regions.promotion: a distinct group that remains connected to the main reading path
major_visual_regions.brand: a protected clear area within the canvas

preferred_relationships.headline: high-impact and clearly associated with the product
preferred_relationships.features: easy to scan without covering protected product features
preferred_relationships.price: clear promotional emphasis after product and headline

composition.visual_flow: diagonal environmental movement gathers around a stable product anchor, then resolves into the promotion group
composition.product_placement_logic: off-center hero anchoring the calmer side of the moving city environment
composition.text_product_relationship: headline occupies counterbalancing negative space while the environmental motion connects text and product
composition.distinctive_device: city movement sweeps around the stable tumbler so the product and key visual idea lead before secondary facts

safe_areas: Keep locked copy and the brand logo comfortably inside the canvas.
Keep the product silhouette and the leaf mark on the product body unobscured.
Separate factual text from visually busy scene details.
asset_protection: Preserve the product silhouette, lid, handle, main colors, and product mark.
Preserve the brand logo geometry, aspect ratio, colors, and upright orientation.
